init.title: Game Event Actions
init.description: Run any Home Assistant actions when game events occur. Each event also fires on the event bus (e.g. mlb_live_scoreboard_team_scored) with a payload you can use in templates as trigger.event.data.team_score, trigger.event.data.opponent_name, trigger.event.data.scoring_play_text, etc.

data_description.data_source_preference: Where the live batter, pitcher, count, plays and box score come from. The other feed is the fallback: with ESPN preferred, MLB fills in when ESPN publishes no play-by-play for a game; with MLB preferred, ESPN is used whenever MLB's feed is unavailable. The score always comes from ESPN. The card shows a small 'via MLB' or 'via ESPN' tag while the fallback is in use.
